chunks: And she took a screen from them, so We sent to her Our Spirit, who appeared to her as a man in full form.

key_terms.حِجَاباً: a screen or partition for seclusion
key_terms.رُوحَنَا: Our Spirit (referring to the Angel Jibril)

ai.seo_question: How did the angel appear to Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Ruhuna' (Our Spirit) is often interpreted as referring specifically to Jibril (Gabriel) or the Holy Spirit, emphasizing his role as the divine messenger rather than a distinct hypostasis. The description of him appearing as 'basharan sawiyyan' (a perfect man) highlights the physical reality of the Annunciation, bridging the spiritual and material realms to prepare Maryam for the miraculous conception of Isa (Jesus). This event is viewed as a unique miracle where the divine word was imparted through a tangible, human-like form to ensure clarity and acceptance.
